## Admin Architecture Standard compliance — complete when this change touches Admin

*Skip this section entirely if this change does not touch Admin navigation, pages, roles, capabilities, APIs, privileged database access, or analytics/reporting.*

- [ ] I read `docs/admin/FHIP_ADMIN_ARCHITECTURE_STANDARD.md`.
- [ ] I identified every affected Admin capability.
- [ ] Navigation, route, API, and database enforcement are independently addressed.
- [ ] Direct-URL and direct-API denial tests are included.
- [ ] Privileged RPC requirements are satisfied, or marked not applicable.
- [ ] Privacy, suppression, and reconstruction controls are addressed, or marked not applicable with reasons.
- [ ] No raw personal or financial information is exposed.
- [ ] Export controls are addressed, or export is not included.
- [ ] Metric definitions and sufficient-data behaviour are documented where applicable.
- [ ] No unrelated Admin scope was absorbed.
- [ ] Any exception is explicitly documented and Product Owner approved.
- [ ] Test and certification evidence is linked or included.
